title: acre-gui links each object in the render to the node that drew it
body:
`scene::build` returns objects with no link to the node that drew them, so the GUI cannot say which source made which pixels. With styles, lets and relative `at`, a reader cannot always tell from the text where a node lands.

## Proposal

- Each scene object carries the span of the node that made it.
- Clicking an object in the render puts the editor's cursor on its node. A cursor inside a node outlines that node's objects in the render.
- The status line shows the canvas coordinates under the pointer.

acre-cfb6e6, dragging to rewrite source, builds on the same link.
